defects_found.description: Eight rows enclose an English phrase in quote marks that departs slightly from the exact WEB wording at the cited verse without an ellipsis flagging the gap. M8-1Kgs-013 truncates WEB 2:22 ('Ask for him the kingdom also,...') and swaps the source's comma for an exclamation point. M8-1Kgs-042 reorders WEB 8:56 ('There has not failed one word of all his good promise...') into 'not one word has failed...'. M8-1Kgs-050 drops 'was made' from WEB 10:20. M8-1Kgs-056 shifts WEB 11:27's 'was' to 'is' and drops 'why'. M8-1Kgs-058 silently elides the middle clause of WEB 12:16 ('We don't have an inheritance in the son of Jesse'). M8-1Kgs-091 drops 'the battle' from WEB 20:14's second clause. M8-1Kgs-099 truncates WEB 22:3 mid-question, omitting '...and don't take it out of the hand of the king of Syria'. M8-1Kgs-100 merges two separate WEB 22:28 sentences by dropping the intervening narration 'He said,'. In every case the underlying verse citation is correct and the paraphrase preserves the original meaning; this is a wording-fidelity issue, not a wrong-verse or fabricated citation, and does not rise to hold-level under the campaign's defect classes.
